title: One shared Accept/Reject-with-reason component
description:
Ryan 11-01: collect explanations on every accept/reject, the same as References, with one standardised UI.
Extract the Reference vote control (curationStatusReason / curationReasonCode) into one component, e.g. components/decision-control.tsx: Accept (Check) and Reject (X) buttons, optional "Why?" textarea (reject opens it; accept offers it), the same reason codes where they apply. Use it for References (unchanged behaviour), link/concept suggestions (S2.9) and generated ideas on the Stories board (forward/spike reason stored on the idea's ReviewRequest or front matter so S4.2 can train on it).
Tests: component tests; existing Reference vote tests still pass.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
UI rules: Lucide icons; buttons + textarea, no dropdowns or popovers; one Accept/Reject vocabulary; a text label beside every mark (never colour alone); no AppSync subscriptions; screenshot review by Ryan on a local dev server before merging.
